Subject:	Important!!! Enpower Shutdown during Thanksgiving Weekend
Importance:	High

Please note Enpower will be shut down for maintenence during the coming Thanksgiving weekend.  IT is planning on running the maintenence from 8:00pm to 4:00am each night from Thursday the 22nd to Sunday the 25th (ending 4:00am on Monday the 26th).  

During the shutdown deal entry and scheduling that are essential to trading activities will be afffected.  During the shut-down hours you may contact Enpower IT at 713-553-3758 (tel) or 713-327-4523 (pager) for emergency.

I have communited with Kate and Cara on the issue.  Please feel free to pass this information to anyone you feel would be impacted.  Please let Risk know if you have any concerns or questions.  

Thank you,

Fran
